item.title: World Health Organization sounds alarm as measles fight stalls
item.description: Global measles deaths hit a historic low in 2025, the World Health Organization said on Friday, although millions of children ⁠still missed vaccinations and outbreaks persisted in dozens of countries. The UN health agency estimated 9.8 million measles cases and about 72,000 deaths worldwide in 2025 — down 74% from 37.8 million cases in 2000, with deaths falling roughly 91% from about 769,000.
